meta.title: Backup
meta.description: Those who know to prepare for a rainy day rarely get themselves in situations too dire.

Rossum Sector, upper levels of the Data Center. Before the battle with Faith—

Remaining Oasis Barrier Uptime - 00:40:21
Rossum Sector, upper levels of the Data Center. Before the battle with Faith—

units.rawText: Antonina steadies her footing as the tremors wash over her, while her hands continue moving without faltering. Before she can respond to all this, she gets a call from Hannah.
units.displayText: Antonina steadies her footing as the tremors wash over her, while her hands continue moving without faltering. Before she can respond to all this, she gets a call from Hannah.

spans.text: Antonina steadies her footing as the tremors wash over her, while her hands continue moving without faltering. Before she can respond to all this, she gets a call from Hannah.

units.rawText: Hannah? What's going on?
units.displayText: Hannah? What's going on?

spans.text: Hannah? What's going on?

units.rawText: Faith is here, and she brought Turing with her.
units.displayText: Faith is here, and she brought Turing with her.

spans.text: Faith is here, and she brought Turing with her.

units.rawText: What?! How did they get here so quickly?!
units.displayText: What?! How did they get here so quickly?!

spans.text: What?! How did they get here so quickly?!

units.rawText: Let's activate the defensive measures we prepared together. There's no avoiding battle now.
units.displayText: Let's activate the defensive measures we prepared together. There's no avoiding battle now.

spans.text: Let's activate the defensive measures we prepared together. There's no avoiding battle now.

units.rawText: Got it, Hannah. You go withdraw the operands. I'll go down to help Persicaria and the others.
units.displayText: Got it, Hannah. You go withdraw the operands. I'll go down to help Persicaria and the others.

spans.text: Got it, Hannah. You go withdraw the operands. I'll go down to help Persicaria and the others.

units.rawText: ...I cannot take on this task. I am making other preparations.
units.displayText: ...I cannot take on this task. I am making other preparations.

spans.text: ...I cannot take on this task. I am making other preparations.

units.rawText: ...What are you planning to do?
units.displayText: ...What are you planning to do?

spans.text: ...What are you planning to do?

units.rawText: You know what I'm talking about. It's the Rewrite Plan.
units.displayText: You know what I'm talking about. It's the Rewrite Plan.

spans.text: You know what I'm talking about. It's the Rewrite Plan.

units.rawText: Calm down, Hannah. Don't take risks like that!
units.displayText: Calm down, Hannah. Don't take risks like that!

spans.text: Calm down, Hannah. Don't take risks like that!

units.rawText: This is the best chance we'll have at making it work. We have an Intermediate Sanctifier, agents who can fight Sanctifiers, a facility for hacking; all the conditions have been met.
units.displayText: This is the best chance we'll have at making it work. We have an Intermediate Sanctifier, agents who can fight Sanctifiers, a facility for hacking; all the conditions have been met.

spans.text: This is the best chance we'll have at making it work. We have an Intermediate Sanctifier, agents who can fight Sanctifiers, a facility for hacking; all the conditions have been met.

units.rawText: It's not a matter of the conditions! I emphasized this before, but we don't know whether the rewrite will even work!
units.displayText: It's not a matter of the conditions! I emphasized this before, but we don't know whether the rewrite will even work!

spans.text: It's not a matter of the conditions! I emphasized this before, but we don't know whether the rewrite will even work!

units.rawText: It will. I've simulated it countless times, Anna. Don't tell me you can't do it with your abilities?
units.displayText: It will. I've simulated it countless times, Anna. Don't tell me you can't do it with your abilities?

spans.text: It will. I've simulated it countless times, Anna. Don't tell me you can't do it with your abilities?

units.rawText: Or are you simply unwilling to accept reality?
units.displayText: Or are you simply unwilling to accept reality?

spans.text: Or are you simply unwilling to accept reality?

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers are massive. No single agent's neural cloud can withstand a computation load of that magnitude...
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers are massive. No single agent's neural cloud can withstand a computation load of that magnitude...

spans.text: The Sanctifiers are massive. No single agent's neural cloud can withstand a computation load of that magnitude...

units.rawText: But I can. You know me.
units.displayText: But I can. You know me.

spans.text: But I can. You know me.

units.rawText: Even if it were you, your neural cloud would break down and disintegrate in the face of such massive calculations!
units.displayText: Even if it were you, your neural cloud would break down and disintegrate in the face of such massive calculations!

spans.text: Even if it were you, your neural cloud would break down and disintegrate in the face of such massive calculations!

units.rawText: Haven't all our efforts been for the sake of letting you and T1641 live on?!
units.displayText: Haven't all our efforts been for the sake of letting you and T1641 live on?!

spans.text: Haven't all our efforts been for the sake of letting you and T1641 live on?!

units.rawText: Of course, and when the plan succeeds, T1641 will be able to survive, while Turing and Rossum will be truly free.
units.displayText: Of course, and when the plan succeeds, T1641 will be able to survive, while Turing and Rossum will be truly free.

spans.text: Of course, and when the plan succeeds, T1641 will be able to survive, while Turing and Rossum will be truly free.

units.rawText: And at that time, I will naturally turn up again.
units.displayText: And at that time, I will naturally turn up again.

spans.text: And at that time, I will naturally turn up again.

units.rawText: Don't be foolish!
units.displayText: Don't be foolish!

spans.text: Don't be foolish!

units.rawText: Go help your friends. They can't hold out much longer.
units.displayText: Go help your friends. They can't hold out much longer.

spans.text: Go help your friends. They can't hold out much longer.

units.rawText: Wait! Where are you going?
units.displayText: Wait! Where are you going?

spans.text: Wait! Where are you going?

units.rawText: I am going to where I ought to be.
units.displayText: I am going to where I ought to be.

spans.text: I am going to where I ought to be.

Rossum Sector, upper levels of the Data Center. After the battle with Faith—

units.rawText: After an intense battle... No, perhaps it should be called a valiant show of resistance, Faith slams Sol into the ground with one hand. Meanwhile, Persicaria's attacks are utterly neutralized by Faith.
units.displayText: After an intense battle... No, perhaps it should be called a valiant show of resistance, Faith slams Sol into the ground with one hand. Meanwhile, Persicaria's attacks are utterly neutralized by Faith.

spans.text: After an intense battle... No, perhaps it should be called a valiant show of resistance, Faith slams Sol into the ground with one hand. Meanwhile, Persicaria's attacks are utterly neutralized by Faith.

units.rawText: (Groans)
units.displayText: Groans

spans.text: Groans

units.rawText: Thud—
units.displayText: Thud—

spans.text: Thud—

units.rawText: Sol!
units.displayText: Sol!

spans.text: Sol!

units.rawText: Your attack methods are unusual. You are not ordinary agents.
units.displayText: Your attack methods are unusual. You are not ordinary agents.

spans.text: Your attack methods are unusual. You are not ordinary agents.

units.rawText: Don't... look down on me!
units.displayText: Don't... look down on me!

spans.text: Don't... look down on me!

units.rawText: Useless.
units.displayText: Useless.

spans.text: Useless.

units.rawText: Faith casually blocks Sol's slash, then grabs her by the collar and lifts her off the ground.
units.displayText: Faith casually blocks Sol's slash, then grabs her by the collar and lifts her off the ground.

spans.text: Faith casually blocks Sol's slash, then grabs her by the collar and lifts her off the ground.

units.rawText: Urgh!!
units.displayText: Urgh!!

spans.text: Urgh!!

units.rawText: [The target's Signature is abnormal. Original address — the Neural Cloud Sector.]
units.displayText: [The target's Signature is abnormal. Original address — the Neural Cloud Sector.]

spans.text: [The target's Signature is abnormal. Original address — the Neural Cloud Sector.]

units.rawText: I see, so that is why you were flagged as abnormal. You should not have left your sector. That is a violation of the basic treaties of Magrasea.
units.displayText: I see, so that is why you were flagged as abnormal. You should not have left your sector. That is a violation of the basic treaties of Magrasea.

spans.text: I see, so that is why you were flagged as abnormal. You should not have left your sector. That is a violation of the basic treaties of Magrasea.

units.rawText: [In accordance with Sanctifier Operational Regulations, Chapter 8, Article 11, I will cleanse you, Irregular Agent.]
units.displayText: [In accordance with Sanctifier Operational Regulations, Chapter 8, Article 11, I will cleanse you, Irregular Agent.]

spans.text: [In accordance with Sanctifier Operational Regulations, Chapter 8, Article 11, I will cleanse you, Irregular Agent.]

units.rawText: <size=48>In accordance with... YOUR BIG FAT ASS!</size>
units.displayText: In accordance with... YOUR BIG FAT ASS!

spans.text: In accordance with... YOUR BIG FAT ASS!

units.rawText: Wham—
units.displayText: Wham—

spans.text: Wham—

units.rawText: Once again, Faith catches Sol's fist.
units.displayText: Once again, Faith catches Sol's fist.

spans.text: Once again, Faith catches Sol's fist.

units.rawText: Cease your pointless resistance. Errors ought to be rectified.
units.displayText: Cease your pointless resistance. Errors ought to be rectified.

spans.text: Cease your pointless resistance. Errors ought to be rectified.

units.rawText: You are the one who should be rectified.
units.displayText: You are the one who should be rectified.

spans.text: You are the one who should be rectified.

units.rawText: A cold voice comes from the shadows. Then, the entire building glows with red light and alarms begin going off one after the other.
units.displayText: A cold voice comes from the shadows. Then, the entire building glows with red light and alarms begin going off one after the other.

spans.text: A cold voice comes from the shadows. Then, the entire building glows with red light and alarms begin going off one after the other.

units.rawText: >Targeting program activated. Signature whitelisting — Dolls, agents, the Professor...
units.displayText: >Targeting program activated. Signature whitelisting — Dolls, agents, the Professor...

spans.text: >Targeting program activated. Signature whitelisting — Dolls, agents, the Professor...

units.rawText: >Overloading program activated. High-pressure pulse aimed. Counting down to operand benchmark shock...
units.displayText: >Overloading program activated. High-pressure pulse aimed. Counting down to operand benchmark shock...

spans.text: >Overloading program activated. High-pressure pulse aimed. Counting down to operand benchmark shock...

units.rawText: >Broad-spectrum communications lockdown initiated.
units.displayText: >Broad-spectrum communications lockdown initiated.

spans.text: >Broad-spectrum communications lockdown initiated.

units.rawText: One system announcement follows another and echoes through the Data Center, like a predator that has been lurking for a long time baring its fangs in the blink of an eye.
units.displayText: One system announcement follows another and echoes through the Data Center, like a predator that has been lurking for a long time baring its fangs in the blink of an eye.

spans.text: One system announcement follows another and echoes through the Data Center, like a predator that has been lurking for a long time baring its fangs in the blink of an eye.

units.rawText: Pulse operand lasers, high-frequency sonic waves, wire-guided data missiles... The weapons hidden in dark corners suddenly open fire, bearing down on Faith in a barrage that fills the heavens and the earth.
units.displayText: Pulse operand lasers, high-frequency sonic waves, wire-guided data missiles... The weapons hidden in dark corners suddenly open fire, bearing down on Faith in a barrage that fills the heavens and the earth.

spans.text: Pulse operand lasers, high-frequency sonic waves, wire-guided data missiles... The weapons hidden in dark corners suddenly open fire, bearing down on Faith in a barrage that fills the heavens and the earth.

units.rawText: The sudden attack forces Faith to drop Sol and then beat a hasty retreat.
units.displayText: The sudden attack forces Faith to drop Sol and then beat a hasty retreat.

spans.text: The sudden attack forces Faith to drop Sol and then beat a hasty retreat.

units.rawText: [Intermediate Sanctifier to all Sanctifiers in Rossum, proceed to the Data Center immediately to render assistance.]
units.displayText: [Intermediate Sanctifier to all Sanctifiers in Rossum, proceed to the Data Center immediately to render assistance.]

spans.text: [Intermediate Sanctifier to all Sanctifiers in Rossum, proceed to the Data Center immediately to render assistance.]

units.rawText: [I repeat, Intermediate Sanctifier to all Sanctifiers in Rossum, proceed to the Data Center immediately to render assistance.]
units.displayText: [I repeat, Intermediate Sanctifier to all Sanctifiers in Rossum, proceed to the Data Center immediately to render assistance.]

spans.text: [I repeat, Intermediate Sanctifier to all Sanctifiers in Rossum, proceed to the Data Center immediately to render assistance.]

units.rawText: I'm guessing you didn't pay attention to the system announcement just now. Need me to refresh your memory, my dear Miss Sanctifier?
units.displayText: I'm guessing you didn't pay attention to the system announcement just now. Need me to refresh your memory, my dear Miss Sanctifier?

spans.text: I'm guessing you didn't pay attention to the system announcement just now. Need me to refresh your memory, my dear Miss Sanctifier?

units.rawText: We've initiated a broad-spectrum comms lockdown. Within the next hour, not a single byte from inside this Data Center will make its way to the outside world.
units.displayText: We've initiated a broad-spectrum comms lockdown. Within the next hour, not a single byte from inside this Data Center will make its way to the outside world.

spans.text: We've initiated a broad-spectrum comms lockdown. Within the next hour, not a single byte from inside this Data Center will make its way to the outside world.

units.rawText: As for those Sanctifiers outside, they've already gone elsewhere "on your orders". So you'd best come along quietly.
units.displayText: As for those Sanctifiers outside, they've already gone elsewhere "on your orders". So you'd best come along quietly.

spans.text: As for those Sanctifiers outside, they've already gone elsewhere "on your orders". So you'd best come along quietly.

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers will not be intimidated— (grunt)
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers will not be intimidated— (grunt)

spans.text: The Sanctifiers will not be intimidated— (grunt)

units.rawText: After seeing that her request for aid is useless, Faith approaches us again, but is forced back again by all manner of attacks.
units.displayText: After seeing that her request for aid is useless, Faith approaches us again, but is forced back again by all manner of attacks.

spans.text: After seeing that her request for aid is useless, Faith approaches us again, but is forced back again by all manner of attacks.

units.rawText: Anna!
units.displayText: Anna!

spans.text: Anna!

units.rawText: Antonina?! What are you doing here?
units.displayText: Antonina?! What are you doing here?

spans.text: Antonina?! What are you doing here?

units.rawText: Now is not the time to reminisce about the past. Has anyone seen Hannah?!
units.displayText: Now is not the time to reminisce about the past. Has anyone seen Hannah?!

spans.text: Now is not the time to reminisce about the past. Has anyone seen Hannah?!

units.rawText: Wasn't she with you?
units.displayText: Wasn't she with you?

spans.text: Wasn't she with you?

units.rawText: Dammit... Where the hell's she run off to now?
units.displayText: Dammit... Where the hell's she run off to now?

spans.text: Dammit... Where the hell's she run off to now?

units.rawText: Thud—
units.displayText: Thud—

spans.text: Thud—

units.rawText: You cannot stop me!
units.displayText: You cannot stop me!

spans.text: You cannot stop me!

units.rawText: The sudden cry interrupts our conversation. Faith forces her way out of the kill box and rushes straight for Antonina.
units.displayText: The sudden cry interrupts our conversation. Faith forces her way out of the kill box and rushes straight for Antonina.

spans.text: The sudden cry interrupts our conversation. Faith forces her way out of the kill box and rushes straight for Antonina.

units.rawText: Antonina, look out!
units.displayText: Antonina, look out!

spans.text: Antonina, look out!

units.rawText: Sol has gotten to her feet at some point after being tossed aside, and she thrusts her long sword into Faith's unprotected back.
units.displayText: Sol has gotten to her feet at some point after being tossed aside, and she thrusts her long sword into Faith's unprotected back.

spans.text: Sol has gotten to her feet at some point after being tossed aside, and she thrusts her long sword into Faith's unprotected back.

units.rawText: Hnnggg!
units.displayText: Hnnggg!

spans.text: Hnnggg!

units.rawText: ...I verify that the strength of Rossum Sector's Irregular Agents has exceeded warning levels.
units.displayText: ...I verify that the strength of Rossum Sector's Irregular Agents has exceeded warning levels.

spans.text: ...I verify that the strength of Rossum Sector's Irregular Agents has exceeded warning levels.

units.rawText: [In accordance with Sanctifier Operational Regulations Chapter 9, Article 27, I am releasing all limiters to cleanse the Irregular Agents.]
units.displayText: [In accordance with Sanctifier Operational Regulations Chapter 9, Article 27, I am releasing all limiters to cleanse the Irregular Agents.]

spans.text: [In accordance with Sanctifier Operational Regulations Chapter 9, Article 27, I am releasing all limiters to cleanse the Irregular Agents.]

units.rawText: Sol, get her. Persicaria, back Sol up. Antonina, fall back and try to disrupt her with all your might!
units.displayText: Sol, get her. Persicaria, back Sol up. Antonina, fall back and try to disrupt her with all your might!

spans.text: Sol, get her. Persicaria, back Sol up. Antonina, fall back and try to disrupt her with all your might!

units.rawText: Roger!
units.displayText: Roger!

spans.text: Roger!

units.rawText: Tch... Got it.
units.displayText: Tch... Got it.

spans.text: Tch... Got it.
